title.zh: 摩根大通将JPM Coin存款代币扩展至以太坊主网面向机构客户
title.en: 【摩根大通正将 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊，面向机构客户】

current_state.zh: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding JPM Coin, its dollar-deposit token, to Ethereum so approved institutional clients can make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions on the public network.
